changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 3 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6051-gantt-flat-config-declared-keys.md`

- names `packages/types/src/index.ts` → `packages/types/src/index.ts` — edited by this change

  > **`GanttConfig` itself gains nine members and is a published type**, exported by name from `packages/types/src/index.ts`: `lockField`, `objectField`, `summaryExtent`, `defaultCollapsedDepth`, `borderColorField`, `dependencyTypes`, `timeZone`, `exportFileName`, `interactions`. The entry file's diff is empty only because the export list already named the type — the widening happened at the declaration.

### `.changeset/6237-wizard-step-config-split.md`

- names `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` → `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` — edited by this change

  > Documentation repair in the same stroke: the support table in the README and in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` still said `formType: 'tabbed'` sections drop the predicate. That stopped being true when the tabbed arm landed — the row now reads **Yes**, the surrounding prose no longer claims two inert arms or a diagnostic that fires for `tabbed`, and the wizard row stays **No**, which is still exactly true.

### `.changeset/uniqueness-deprecation-jsdoc-4765.md`

- names `packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts` → `packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts` — edited by this change

  > Corrects the `@deprecated` prescription on `UniquenessValidation` in `packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts`, which pointed authors at spellings the platform no longer accepts (objectui#4765).

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `f308a655b` (merge-base with origin/main): 4 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1571 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2159 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36300379729)

Head-sha: `c68bc62abfc88d1f5ca544fe6003e7956c38b468`

### ① Derived judgments

**Public-surface changes, enumerated (three, nothing more).**
1. The eight type re-exports leave the `@object-ui/types` root barrel (`packages/types/src/index.ts`, base `:607`–`:614`). The index.ts diff is exactly 9 removed lines: the eight names and their one `// Validation Schema (Phase 3.5)` comment. Running the pin's own `export {…}` parser over base and head `index.ts` gives 664 published names before and 656 after: precisely eight fewer, so no other name left the barrel.
2. The eight declarations and the "Phase 3.5: ValidationSchema - Complete Validation Engine" banner leave `packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts`. The single 241-line hunk (`@@ -661,241 +661,15 @@`) contains only the banner, `AdvancedValidationSchema`, `AdvancedValidationRule`, `ValidationRuleType`, `ValidationFunction`, `AsyncValidationFunction`, `ValidationContext`, `AdvancedValidationResult`, `AdvancedValidationError`, and the new nine-line `//` retirement note. The 237 deleted lines are 235 from that hunk plus 2 from the header. No live type went with them: `FieldValidationRules` (index.ts:189), `FieldValidationFunction` (:499), `ObjectValidationRule` (:619) and its spec-derived variants `BaseValidation`…`RangeValidation`, `DesignerValidationRule` (:735) all still ship; the object-level rule section that follows the deleted block is byte-unchanged. `data-protocol` is not a subpath door: `packages/types/package.json` `exports` has no `./data-protocol`, no subpath barrel has an `export *`, and the only non-test file in `packages/types/src` that imports from `./data-protocol.js` is `index.ts:637`. So the root `.` was the one door, as the PR says.
3. The `@packageDocumentation` header (data-protocol.ts:12-13) changes "ValidationSchema" to "object-level validation rules". That docblock ships in the emitted `.d.ts`; the new wording is accurate (the file still declares `ObjectValidationRule` and its variants) and carries no contract.

**Readers, re-measured.**
- objectui at head, whole tracked tree, `git grep -w` of all eight, CHANGELOGs excluded: hits only in the five `.changeset/*.md` files (prose), the new pin, the retirement note itself, `scripts/__tests__/check-doc-component-types.test.ts` (string fixtures and a comment) and `scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts` (a past-tense comment). Zero type readers. Base control: the same instrument at `origin/main` over `packages apps examples` (tests excluded) lights exactly the two home files, 17 and 8 lines. Lit control at head: `FieldValidationRules` answers in 14 files. `origin/main` has not grown a reader since the merge-base `01700dcd7` (same file list, only the base home files plus the prose sites).
- objectstack `origin/main` `e2c4e12`: `git grep -l -w` of all eight gives 0 files; a substring grep (`AdvancedValidation|AsyncValidationFunction|ValidationRuleType`) also 0. Lit control: `@object-ui/types` names 37 files. Matches the PR's reading exactly.
- Emitted `.d.ts` of another package: neither checkout has a `dist/` (0 `.d.ts` under any `dist`), so this is derived, not read: a package's `.d.ts` can only carry these names if its source imports them, and no source outside `packages/types/src/{data-protocol,index}.ts` does, nor does any subpath barrel of `@object-ui/types` re-export `data-protocol`. Zero by construction; the dev's BASE-build measurement (only `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/data-protocol.d.ts`) is consistent with that.
- Out-of-repo consumers: NOT MEASURED, and every record (card, changeset, PR) says so. Same limit as ruling A.

**Loud for a TS consumer.** Yes. A named import of any of the eight from `@object-ui/types` is TS2305 (module has no exported member); the pin's `import('../index.js').Name` spelling gets TS2694 for the same absence. There is no silent-`any` path: no ambient re-declaration, no `export *` in the barrel.

**The pin: can it fail?** Yes, on both legs.
- Compile time: 16 `@ts-expect-error` probes (eight through the barrel, eight through the module) plus three undirected controls. Root `tsconfig.json:62` has `"noUnusedLocals": false`, so the only diagnostic a probe line can produce is the missing member; a returning name therefore yields TS2578 rather than being swallowed by an unused-alias error. This is the condition that keeps the directives honest, and I verified it in config rather than taking the PR's word. `tsconfig.test.json` includes `src/**/*.test.ts` and `packages/types/package.json` chains it from `type-check`; the build `tsconfig.json` excludes `**/__tests__/**` so the pin cannot emit into `dist`.
- Runtime leg: the `Object.keys` reasoning is correct. All eight were `export type`, which leaves no runtime binding, so the objectui#7659 core pin's `Object.keys(corePublicEntry)` shape (it pins runtime values) reads identically before and after for these names; the `ai-insights-retired-8800.test.ts` pin in the same directory records the same reason at lines 51-57. Replacing it with a source-text read is the right call, not a weakening.
- Reverse verification, reproduced cheaply: I ran the pin's two matchers (`declares`, `reexported`) against `origin/main`'s `data-protocol.ts` and `index.ts`: 8 of 8 declared, 8 of 8 re-exported, controls lit; against head: 0 of 8, 0 of 8, controls lit. So the "2 vitest failures on base" claim holds. The 16 × TS2578 claim follows from the directive semantics plus `noUnusedLocals: false`; I did not re-run `tsc` (gate family). The head Type Check run is what proves the 16 probes compile today; see ③.
- Non-blocking nit: a name re-introduced through an `export * from` line in the barrel would evade the text parser (it only reads `export {…}` lists) but not the compile-time leg, so the pin still reddens. The barrel has no `export *` today.

### ② Semver level

- `'@object-ui/types': minor` with a BREAKING banner is right. objectui `AGENTS.md:271`: the repository's own breaking changes are scored `minor` with the breaking semantics stated in the body (the fixed group must not cross a major except in lockstep with objectstack); `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` enforces it. Head checks "Changeset Bump Policy" and "Changeset Declaration" are green.
- Every sentence of `.changeset/10719-retire-phase35-validation-types.md` checks out: the eight names; "type half of `ValidationEngine`" and ruling A on objectui#7659 (comment 5548579814, batch #40 item 4, ADR-0049); "nothing in this repository or in the ObjectStack framework reads them" (measured above); "no deprecation window" (true, none was declared); replacement: `FieldValidationRules.validate` exists (`form.ts:1522`), `buildValidationRules` is `packages/fields/src/index.tsx:3769` in `@object-ui/fields` and compiles `required`, `minLength`/`maxLength`, `min`/`max`, `pattern`, plus type-implied `email`/`url` checks; the "Not affected" list is exactly the four names still in the barrel; NOT MEASURED stated.
- The four dated notes: each is a pure insertion (`+4`, `+4`, `+7`, `+5` lines, no deletions), leaves the original paragraph intact, follows the 41-file "Dated note, date — …" convention (e.g. `7742-kanban-arm-batch70.md:36`), and is true: `9909` ("`ValidationContext` itself is removed … so the `locale` member this entry adds no longer exists"), `7659` ("those types no longer keep their shapes: all eight … are removed … on this same ruling"), `6349` ("data-protocol's `ValidationFunction` is removed … `FieldValidationFunction` stays published", index.ts:499 confirms), `7357` ("`AdvancedValidationRule` is removed … so its `depends_on` no longer exists"). Frontmatter untouched in all four; "Changeset Overwrite Report" and "Changeset Claim Re-read" green.
- `plugin-form.mdx`: true. The remaining near-spellings `ObjectValidationRule` (data-protocol.ts) and `DesignerValidationRule` (designer.ts) exist and neither types `validation`; the sentence "There is no `ValidationRule` type in this repository" that `check-doc-component-types.test.ts` pins is kept; "Doc Component Type Check" green.

- **`scripts/__tests__/check-doc-component-types.test.ts` fixture addresses: correctly deferred, not a defect of this PR.** Lines 2518-2519 keep `'export interface AdvancedValidationRule {}' // …data-protocol.ts:708` and `"export type ValidationRuleType = 'required';" // …data-protocol.ts:748` as negatives under a comment saying each is "a spelling this repository really writes, cited where it lives"; the docblock at :2427 is already self-dated ("when this was written"). The fixtures are strings and remain valid negatives, so the test is green; the line-citation gate (`scripts/check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs`) counts only citations NEW relative to base and says existing ones are not its denominator, so nothing reddens. The file is outside the claim's file surface and the dev recorded it in the PR. - **Check runs at head, as they stand:** 42 runs, 30 success, 3 skipped (dependabot, coverage), 0 failed, 9 still in progress at the time of this review: Type Check, Test shards 1-4 and 6-8, Spec Main Shape Gate. Type Check is the run that proves the 16 compile-time probes; the dev reports `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` exit 0 at `c68bc62ab`, and my config read (`noUnusedLocals: false`, test project chained) supports it. Non-blocking: the PM should see Type Check and Spec Main Shape Gate conclude green before merge.

- Commit trailers are `Co-Authored-By: Claude` (model-free) with the session line; the dev states this follows the os-dev definition over the harness reminder. Outside contract scope; noted only.
